backend: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (radeonsi phoenix ACO), OpenGL ES 3.2)
method: Freeze application requestAnimationFrame callbacks after capturing all 206 dominant draws in one frame. Retain actual GPU mesh/records/material/samplers/portal metadata/envelope in the original GLES context; copy scene RGBA8 color and DEPTH_COMPONENT24 depth before the first dominant draw to a private framebuffer. Replay only captured dominant draws, resetting background color outside each elapsed GPU query. No DAT assets or pixel arrays exported.
timingContract: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2; each sample times replay draw/uniform commands only, excludes background reset and readback. Eight warm-up replays discarded per window. No disjoint samples or GL errors accepted. Window means summarized by median/min/max, not a live FPS comparison.
limitations: Frozen stationary view only; isolated cost excludes other particles, other rendering phases, CPU scene work, presentation, and reset blits. Viewports differ slightly between captures. Phased runs reuse the exact same frozen inputs.

A requestAnimationFrame freeze retains the live host connection for resource lifetime; this is not a portable fixture independent of live login. No extra live dominant draw calls were observed after freezing.

Batch diagnostic uses a 206-entry vertex uniform slot-remap array and one instanced draw. It preserves captured dominant draw order; all particles select per-record frames. Stale range-frame uniforms differ but are unread when uUsesRangeFrame is zero.
Color-envelope diagnostic copies the root viewport into an R32F color texture and rebinds it on unit 5; applies only to captured root-domain particles.
Pixel equality establishes this frozen output only, not general portal correctness or visual acceptance. Actual GLES shader invocation counts, occupancy, and memory stalls remain unmeasured.
Expanded diagnostics change the no-portal control timing on the same frozen inputs, so batching/format ablations cannot be used as clean production-optimization comparisons.
failedAttempts: First expanded follow-up refused batching because stale, unused range-frame uniforms differed. No measurements from that attempt accepted; corrected guard requires uUsesRangeFrame=0 and permits only these unread differences.
Initial telemetry source failed Node syntax validation before client launch; corrected script is archived.

resolution.cause: Repeated direct CPU reads of the measured color target, reaching a tenth-transfer APU layout heuristic; additional program creation itself is not required. Use staged-readback results for uncontaminated expanded ablations.
